Name: Pokeball Bobbers
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod adds 10 different bobbers for you to use with your fishing rod, each styled after a particular kind of Pokéball from the Pokémon series. Each of these bobbers comes with a customized fishing line colour for your fishing rod that will be used when the bobber is applied. The 10 bobber styles are the standard Pokéball, Great Ball, Ultra Ball, Master Ball, Love Ball, Premier Ball, Quick Ball, Fast Ball, Dream Ball, and GS Ball. More in the future, maybe!

These bobbers [b]do not replace the vanilla bobbers[/b]! Using the power of Bebber Bobbers, these are 10 [i]entirely new bobbers[/i] for you to use in addition to the vanilla ones!

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36655]Install the latest version of Bebber Bobbers[/url]﻿.
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
